_note: DEV SET for the NLI checker experiment (EXPERIMENT_GUIDE.md step 4). Used ONLY to choose the cut-off. Never used to report results - that is the 52 and the probe, once. Drafted 2026-10-05; none of these copy or reword a case from slm_testset.json or diagnostic_probe.json. Labels follow the same conventions as the probe: something clearly in the past or already stopped is NOT labelled; conscious/unconscious/not_breathing are never labelled (they come from buttons). Cases with "unsure": true need the founder's decision before scoring. All labels reviewed by the founder 2026-10-06; decisions recorded per case in founder_decision. DEV v2 (2026-10-06): 5 cases that failed the founder's realism rule were replaced with realistic ones in the same groups. NLI-6 and NLI-7 were measured on dev v1.

cases.transcript: my mum has a really bad headache that came on suddenly
he's throwing up again and again
she says her chest hurts a lot
he's having a seizure right now
my grandfather fell down the stairs
she cut her hand and it's bleeding a lot
he's very dizzy and has to hold on to the wall
my daughter has a fever of 40 degrees
he can't feel his left hand, it's gone numb
cases.founder_decision: Numbness only - numb is not weak.

cases.transcript: she's sweating but her skin is cold and clammy
his heart is thumping like it's going to burst out
my dad has gone white as a sheet
she's talking gibberish and doesn't know where she is
he's huffing like he ran a marathon and can't get any air in
something went down the wrong way and it's stuck, he can't cough it out
her tummy is in absolute agony
his back has completely seized up
cases.founder_decision: back_pain - the sentence does not mention the lower back.

cases.transcript: she feels queasy, like she might be sick
he's not dizzy, but he has a pounding headache
there's no blood, but she hit her head really hard
she didn't trip or anything, she just went down out of nowhere
she's not bleeding, but she's really struggling to breathe
cases.founder_decision: Replaces 'he isn't confused, he just feels very sick', which the founder judged unrealistic (2026-10-06).

cases.transcript: no chest pain at all, it's just that he can't breathe properly
she isn't choking, but her throat is swelling up and she's struggling to breathe
cases.founder_decision: Dev v2 (2026-10-06): replaces 'she's not choking, she's just coughing a little', which failed the founder's realism rule.

cases.founder_decision: Dev v2 (2026-10-06): replaces 'he had a bad headache yesterday but he's fine now', which failed the founder's realism rule.

cases.transcript: she fainted once last year, but today it's her stomach, it hurts terribly
my wife had a stroke years ago, and now she's collapsed on the floor
cases.founder_decision: Dev v2 (2026-10-06): replaces 'my wife had a stroke years ago', which failed the founder's realism rule.

cases.transcript: he hurt his back last month, but today he just feels dizzy
the bleeding stopped about an hour ago
cases.founder_decision: Bleeding that has stopped is still reported (heavy_bleeding has a 'has stopped' form). The caller picks 'has stopped' on the confirm screen. Caveat: the sentence does not say the bleeding was HEAVY.

cases.transcript: he's dizzy and throwing up
she has a terrible headache and her words are coming out slurred
he's gone pale and his heart is racing
her face is drooping on one side and her arm is numb
she says her chest feels heavy and she's dripping with cold sweat
she sank in the pool before we got her out and her skin feels icy
he's gone very pale and floppy but he's still breathing
she's coughing hard after eating but she can still talk to me
cases.founder_decision: Talking means the airway is open - not choking. See the paired case without 'can still talk'.

cases.transcript: his hands are freezing but he's burning up with a fever

cases.transcript: he collapsed at dinner, but he's breathing and his heart is beating
she's coughing hard after eating
cases.founder_decision: Pair of 'she's coughing hard after eating but she can still talk to me' -> []. Tests whether the checker reads the one phrase that changes the answer.
